Paul and Timothy, servants of Christ Jesus, To all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, together with the overseers and deacons:
Paul and Timothy, servants of Jesus Christ, to all the saints in Christ Jesus at Philippi, with the Bishops and Deacons of the church:
基督耶穌的僕人保羅和提摩太寫信給凡住腓立比、在基督耶穌裡的眾聖徒，和諸位監督，諸位執事。
Grace and peace to you from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
願恩惠、平安從神我們的父並主耶穌基督歸與你們！
I thank my God every time I remember you.
I give praise to my God at every memory of you,
我每逢想念你們，就感謝我的神；
In every prayer for all of you, I always pray with joy,
And in all my prayers for you all, making my request with joy,
每逢為你們眾人祈求的時候，常是歡歡喜喜地祈求。
because of your partnership in the gospel from the first day until now,
Because of your help in giving the good news from the first day till now;
因為從頭一天直到如今，你們是同心合意地興旺福音。
being confident of this, that He who began a good work in you will carry it on to completion until the day of Christ Jesus.
For I am certain of this very thing, that he by whom the good work was started in you will make it complete till the day of Jesus Christ:
我深信那在你們心裡動了善工的，必成全這工，直到耶穌基督的日子。
It is right for me to feel this way about all of you, since I have you in my heart. For in my chains and in my defense and confirmation of the gospel, you are all partners in grace with me.

So it is right for me to take thought for you all in this way, because I have you in my heart; for in my chains, and in my arguments before the judges in support of the good news, making clear that it is true, you all have your part with me in grace.
我為你們眾人有這樣的意念，原是應當的；因你們常在我心裡，無論我是在捆鎖之中，是辯明證實福音的時候，你們都與我一同得恩。
God is my witness how I long for all of you with the affection of Christ Jesus.
For God is my witness, how my love goes out to you all in the loving mercies of Christ Jesus.
我體會基督耶穌的心腸，切切地想念你們眾人；這是神可以給我作見證的。
And this is my prayer: that your love may abound more and more in knowledge and depth of insight,
And my prayer is that you may be increased more and more in knowledge and experience;
我所禱告的，就是要你們的愛心在知識和各樣見識上多而又多，
so that you may be able to test and prove what is best and may be pure and blameless for the day of Christ,
So that you may give your approval to the best things; that you may be true and without wrongdoing till the day of Christ;
使你們能分別是非（或譯：喜愛那美好的事），作誠實無過的人，直到基督的日子；
filled with the fruit of righteousness that comes through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
Being full of the fruits of righteousness, which are through Jesus Christ, to the glory and praise of God.
並靠著耶穌基督結滿了仁義的果子，叫榮耀稱讚歸與神。
Now I want you to know, brothers, that my circumstances have actually served to advance the gospel.
Now it is my purpose to make clear to you, brothers, that the cause of the good news has been helped by my experiences;
弟兄們，我願意你們知道，我所遭遇的事更是叫福音興旺，
As a result, it has become clear throughout the whole palace guard and to everyone else that I am in chains for Christ.
So that it became clear through all the Praetorium, and to all the rest, that I was a prisoner on account of Christ;
以致我受的捆鎖在御營全軍和其餘的人中，已經顯明是為基督的緣故。
And most of the brothers, confident in the Lord by my chains, now dare more greatly to speak the word without fear.
And most of the brothers in the Lord, taking heart because of my chains, are all the stronger to give the word of God without fear.
並且那在主裡的弟兄多半因我受的捆鎖就篤信不疑，越發放膽傳神的道，無所懼怕。
It is true that some preach Christ out of envy and rivalry, but others out of goodwill.
Though some are preaching Christ out of envy and competition, others do it out of a good heart:
有的傳基督是出於嫉妒紛爭，也有的是出於好意。
The latter do so in love, knowing that I am appointed for the defense of the gospel.
These do it from love, conscious that I am responsible for the cause of the good news:
這一等是出於愛心，知道我是為辯明福音設立的；
The former, however, preach Christ out of selfish ambition, not sincerely, supposing that they can add to the distress of my chains.
But those are preaching Christ in a spirit of competition, not from their hearts, but with the purpose of giving me pain in my prison.
那一等傳基督是出於結黨，並不誠實，意思要加增我捆鎖的苦楚。
What then is the issue? Just this: that in every way, whether by false motives or true, Christ is preached. And in this I rejoice. Yes, and I will continue to rejoice,
What then? only that in every way, falsely or truly, the preaching of Christ goes on; and in this I am glad, and will be glad.
這有何妨呢？或是假意，或是真心，無論怎樣，基督究竟被傳開了。為此，我就歡喜，並且還要歡喜；
because I know that through your prayers and the provision of the Spirit of Jesus Christ, my distress will turn out for my deliverance.
For I am conscious that this will be for my salvation, through your prayer and the giving out of the stored wealth of the Spirit of Jesus Christ,
因為我知道，這事藉著你們的祈禱和耶穌基督之靈的幫助，終必叫我得救。
I eagerly expect and hope that I will in no way be ashamed, but will have complete boldness so that now as always Christ will be exalted in my body, whether by life or by death.
In the measure of my strong hope and belief that in nothing will I be put to shame, but that without fear, as at all times, so now will Christ have glory in my body, by life or by death.
照著我所切慕、所盼望的，沒有一事叫我羞愧。只要凡事放膽，無論是生是死，總叫基督在我身上照常顯大。
For to me, to live is Christ, and to die is gain.
For to me life is Christ and death is profit.
因我活著就是基督，我死了就有益處。
But if I go on living in the body, this will mean fruitful labor for me. So what shall I choose? I do not know.
But if I go on living in the flesh--if this is the fruit of my work--then I do not see what decision to make.
但我在肉身活著，若成就我工夫的果子，我就不知道該挑選甚麼。
I am torn between the two. I desire to depart and be with Christ, which is far better indeed.
I am in a hard position between the two, having a desire to go away and be with Christ, which is very much better:
我正在兩難之間，情願離世與基督同在，因為這是好得無比的。
But it is more necessary for you that I remain in the body.
Still, to go on in the flesh is more necessary because of you.
然而，我在肉身活著，為你們更是要緊的。
Convinced of this, I know that I will remain and will continue with all of you for your progress and joy in the faith,
And being certain of this, I am conscious that I will go on, yes, and go on with you all, for your growth and joy in the faith;
我既然這樣深信，就知道仍要住在世間，且與你們眾人同住，使你們在所信的道上又長進又喜樂，
so that through my coming to you again your exultation in Christ Jesus will resound on account of me.
So that your pride in me may be increased in Christ Jesus through my being present with you again.
叫你們在基督耶穌裡的歡樂，因我再到你們那裡去，就越發加增。

Nevertheless, conduct yourselves in a manner worthy of the gospel of Christ. Then, whether I come and see you or only hear about you in my absence, I will know that you stand firm in one spirit, contending side by side for the faith of the gospel,

Only let your behaviour do credit to the good news of Christ, so that if I come and see you or if I am away from you, I may have news of you that you are strong in one spirit, working together with one soul for the faith of the good news;
只要你們行事為人與基督的福音相稱，叫我或來見你們，或不在你們那裡，可以聽見你們的景況，知道你們同有一個心志，站立得穩，為所信的福音齊心努力。
without being frightened in any way by those who oppose you. This is a clear sign of their destruction but of your salvation, and it is from God.
Having no fear of those who are against you; which is a clear sign of their destruction, but of your salvation, and that from God;
凡事不怕敵人的驚嚇，這是證明他們沉淪，你們得救都是出於神。
For it has been granted to you on behalf of Christ not only to believe in Him, but also to suffer for Him,
Because to you it has been given in the cause of Christ not only to have faith in him, but to undergo pain on his account:
因為你們蒙恩，不但得以信服基督，並要為他受苦。
since you are encountering the same struggle you saw I had, and now hear that I still have.
Fighting the same fight which you saw in me, and now have word of in me.
你們的爭戰，就與你們在我身上從前所看見、現在所聽見的一樣。
